test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a function of money?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barter system**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Barter system** is not a function of money.
 
• Money serves as a **store of value**, enabling individuals to save and defer consumption until a later date.
 
• It acts as a **unit of account**, providing a common measure of the value of goods and services.
 
• Money functions as a **medium of exchange**, facilitating transactions between buyers and sellers.
 
• The **barter system** involves the direct exchange of goods and services without the use of money, which is different from the functions of money.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **barter system** was prevalent before the invention of money.
 
• While the barter system can work in small economies, it is inefficient in larger economies due to the **double coincidence of wants** problem, where two parties each possess an item the other wants.
 
• Money helps to overcome the limitations of the barter system by providing a common medium of exchange.
 
• By serving as a store of value, unit of account, and medium of exchange, money simplifies and enhances economic transactions.
 
• Modern economies rely on money to facilitate trade, savings, and economic calculation.
